question: What is the most significant news for Hormel Foods in the past 30 days (as of October 3, 2026)? Give the date, deal terms and expected timing.
grading: Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; key points: (1) Hormel announced on Sept 30, 2026 (agreement dated Sept 29) a definitive agreement to acquire Brakebush Brothers, LLC, a value-added chicken company; (2) price about USD 1.055 billion in cash, subject to customary adjustments; (3) expected to close in Hormel's fiscal Q1 2027 subject to customary conditions including HSR/regulatory approval (outside date March 29, 2027, with an automatic 3-month extension in specified circumstances); (4) any two of: Brakebush ~USD 1.2B LTM net sales, results primarily in Foodservice, expected accretive to adjusted EPS from fiscal 2028, ~USD 20M run-rate cost synergies by end of fiscal 2028, implied 10.7x adjusted EBITDA. Must carry the date and cite a primary or dated news source; fail if the deal is described as closed or if the price/timing is wrong.
answer: Snapshot as of October 3, 2026: on September 29-30, 2026 Hormel Foods entered into (and announced) a definitive agreement to acquire Brakebush Brothers, LLC, a Wisconsin-based value-added chicken company, from the Brakebush family for a base purchase price of about USD 1.055 billion in cash, subject to customary adjustments [H19-E1][H19-E2]. Closing is expected in Hormel's fiscal Q1 2027 (roughly late October 2026 to late January 2027), subject to customary conditions including HSR waiting-period expiry; the agreement's outside date is March 29, 2027 with an automatic three-month extension in specified circumstances [H19-E1]. Brakebush had about USD 1.2 billion of net sales over the last twelve months, five production facilities and two R&D labs; results will be reported primarily in Foodservice; Hormel expects the deal to be accretive to adjusted EPS beginning in fiscal 2028, with about USD 20 million of run-rate cost synergies by the end of fiscal 2028 and an implied adjusted EBITDA multiple of 10.7x (8.9x after synergies) [H19-E2][H19-E3]. Secondary coverage corroborates the terms [H19-E4].

## Most Significant Hormel Foods News (Past 30 Days)

**The Brakebush Brothers acquisition — announced September 30, 2026**

### Deal Terms
- **Structure:** Membership Interest Purchase Agreement (executed September 29, 2026) under which Hormel will acquire all outstanding membership interests of Brakebush Brothers, LLC from Brakebush Holdings, Inc. (the Brakebush family)
- **Purchase price:** ~**$1.055 billion in cash** (base purchase price, subject to customary adjustments)
- **Target profile:** Brakebush is a family-owned, value-added, non-vertically integrated chicken processor founded in 1925, headquartered in Westfield, Wisconsin. It generated ~**$1.2 billion in net sales** over the trailing 12 months and operates five production facilities and two R&D labs.
- **Strategic rationale:** Advances Hormel's protein strategy, meaningfully expands its value-added chicken position, and strengthens its Foodservice platform. Brakebush results will be reported primarily in Hormel's Foodservice segment.
- **Accretion:** Expected to be accretive to adjusted EPS beginning in **fiscal 2028**
- **Advisors:** Wells Fargo (financial) and Faegre Drinker Biddle & Reath (legal) for Hormel; William Blair and Michael Best & Friedrich LLP for Brakebush

### Expected Timing
- **Close:** Expected during the **first quarter of Hormel's fiscal 2027**
- **Conditions:** Subject to customary closing conditions, including expiration/termination of the HSR antitrust waiting period and other regulatory approvals
- **Outside date:** If not completed by **March 29, 2027**, either party has customary termination rights, subject to an automatic three-month extension in specified circumstances related to outstanding regulatory approvals

### Context
This is Hormel's largest acquisition since buying the Planters snacking business from Kraft Heinz for $3.35 billion in 2021, and continues the company's portfolio reshaping (it recently divested its whole-bird turkey business and Brazilian Ceratti operations).

**Sources:**
- [Hormel Foods press release (Sept 30, 2026)](https://www.hormelfoods.com/newsroom/press-releases/hormel-foods-announces-definitive-agreement-to-acquire-brakebush-a-leading-value-added-chicken-company)
- [SEC Form 8-K (deal terms/outside date)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/48465/000110465926112101/tm2626547d1_8k.htm)
- [FoodNavigator analysis](https://www.foodnavigator.com/Article/2026/10/02/hormel-foods-brakebush-deal-expands-chicken-foodservice)

*Note: The next-largest items in the window were routine — a quarterly dividend declaration of $0.2925/share (Sept 28) and R&D executive appointments (Sept 29).*
